info.title: PLATO-40 Building Operations API
info.description:
Interface for running the decision pipeline on live systems instead of the replayed dataset.

**Status: a design, not a running service.** The hackathon submission reads a directory of files and writes `decisions.jsonl`; no server implements these paths yet. The field names are those of the PLATO-40 dataset and of DECISION_CONTRACT v2, so a connector that fills these feeds gives the detectors exactly what they read today.

Three directions: **ingest** (real systems push rows in), **decisions and approvals** (people and dashboards read and answer), **actions** (the system calls a connector, the connector reports back). PLATO-40 is a fictional property; nothing here describes a real PLATO building or what CLARA does today.

servers.description: Placeholder. There is no deployed server.

tags.name: Ingest
tags.description: Connectors push rows here, one feed per table the detectors read. Every row carries the time it happened; where the dataset has a column for when a row became known, that column is required, because a decision may only use what was known at its moment. Rows are idempotent: sending a row again changes nothing, sending a changed row replaces it.

tags.name: Decisions
tags.description: What the system decided, with the evidence, as cases and as single decisions.

tags.name: Approvals
tags.description: Decisions that wait for a person. The rules live in the pipeline, not in the caller: an approval for a decision that needs guest consent is refused until the consent is on record.

tags.name: Actions
tags.description: Actions leave as webhooks to the connector of the target system. The connector reports back here.

tags.name: Emergency
tags.description: Bridge a caller to the on-call team and hand the team one case.

post.summary: The system asks a connector to carry out an action
post.description: Sent to the URL registered for the action. The request carries the same X-Auth key the connector was given and an X-Signature header: HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the shared secret. Answer 2xx with an ActionResult; a slow target system answers `accepted` and reports the outcome later to /actions/{action_id}/result.

Decision.description: One decision, exactly as written to decisions.jsonl (DECISION_CONTRACT v2).

episode_id.description: Groups the decisions of one case

timestamp_utc.description: The moment the decision is taken, using only information available at that time

DecisionState.description: A decision with what happened to it since.

decided_by.description: The person who approved or rejected

Case.description: All decisions of one episode, oldest first.

feeds.description: One entry per ingest feed: a silent feed is a finding, not a quiet building.

Consent.description: Proof that the guest agreed. A consent requirement is not consent granted.

given_by.description: Booking id of the guest, not a name

decided_by.description: Identity of the approver from the identity provider

ActionRequest.description: What a connector is asked to do. Sent once per action; repeat deliveries carry the same action_id.

parameters.description: Action-specific values, for example room_id and setpoint_c, or the message text and language

dry_run.description: true while the deployment runs in shadow mode: log it, do not do it

not_after_utc.description: Do not carry the action out after this time

external_reference.description: Id in the target system, for example a work order or message id

episode_id.description: The case it is about, if known

asset_id.description: Room or asset, if no case is known

callback_number.description: Number to bridge to the on-call team

on_call.description: Role that was reached, not a private number
